$comment: The known-failures record (docs/rig-suites.md). Each entry is ONE cause, the date it was recorded, every suite under it BY NAME (no wildcards), and a `probe`: a command that exits 0 while the cause still holds. The runner runs each probe once at the start; the suites of a cause that still holds are SKIPPED and printed with the cause, and the suites of a cleared cause run again by themselves. rig/verdict.mjs names every red suite that is not listed. Nothing here makes a run green.
